_doc: Per suite and profile: 'required' must PASS/HOLD (blocker if not); 'known_p2' may fail (tolerated, listed); anything else failing = REGRESSION. Patterns are substrings of the pytest node id or MATRIX id. '_informational_matrix' rows are historical demonstrations of raw git behaviour or pre-#276 expectations superseded by design (TA-10 -> TA-10a/10b; TA-11 -> TA-11', see VERDICT_276 §3) and never gate.

stop_classification._note: CORRECTED after the harness 404-fidelity fix: FO-6 (untyped error / crash at the push boundary on an envelope-governed Path A goal) is NOT contained - governed recovery declines takeover, the retry tick re-dispatches, each attempt re-runs the paid code agent (bounded by max_attempts: 2 extra paid runs) and the task is stranded `ready`. FO-6 family (untyped_boundary_exception, FO6b, FO6x, RL) is REQUIRED (P1). FO-7/FO-7x (approved-base fetch at worktree creation -> bounded paid replans) stay P2. FO-7n (#290 neighbour fix) required.

cursor._superseded_note: DB-level probes that hand _finalize_task_outcome a TaskExecutionError carrying the failure as MESSAGE TEXT (the #286 shape). From #288 production never reports push/grant/base/GitHub failures that way (typed ExternalBoundaryError at the real origin), and text is deliberately ignored. Their intent is gated end-to-end by stop_classification FO-1..FO-6 at the real origins. Codex contract: grant/transport denials MUST be raised as typed ExternalBoundaryError (GrantDeniedError) or inside the push boundary.
